To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
COX‐1 and COX‐2 are differentially expressed during development in the renal medulla and renal cortex, and the response of COX‐1 mRNA to hypoxia changes with age, but COX‐2 is not affected by age.
COX‐1 mRNA was induced by hypoxemia in renal cortical tissue of developing rats, but COX‐1 and COX‐2 mRNAs were induced by hypoxemic stress in the inner medulla of developing animals.
COX‐2 and COX‐4 expression in the renal cortex is upregulated by hypoxia at birth, and COX‐2 expression in the renal medulla is downregulated by hypoxis at 2 weeks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of prostaglandin E 2 (PGE 2 ) in the regulation of renal function.
the role of the prostaglandins and cyclooxygenase enzymes in the regulation of renal function and blood pressure.
the development and application of a new class of catalyst, the metalloporphyrins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the COX‐2 expression is increased in the renal medulla during the development of rats.
the development of the kidney is characterized by a gradual increase in renal blood flow, glomerular filtration rate, and tubular reabsorption.
the COX‐2 gene is induced in the developing rat kidney in response to hypoxia and that the induction is greater in the renal medulla compared to the cortex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

COX‐2 is induced by hypoxiain both the cortex and medulla in developing rats, and this induction is more pronounced in the medulla than the cortex, and that the induction is greater in younger than in adult animals.
the expression and activity of COX enzymes is altered in the kidney in response to hypoxia in a developmentally‐dependent manner.
the developmental changes in COX‐1 and COX‐2 expression and their responses to hypoxic stress in rat kidney may be related to the maturation of renal hemodynamic and epithelial functions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

COX‐2 is expressed at high levels in the kidney and that this expression is regulated by developmental changes in response to hypoxia, which may have implications for the development of kidney function.
the developmental expression of COX mRNA is differentially regulated in the renal cortex versus the renal medulla.
there are age‐related changes to COX‐1 and COX‐2 expression in the kidney.
